name: io.github.smeet666/mcp-animenewsnetwork
description: Search the Anime News Network encyclopedia and read its news wire. No API key.

environmentVariables.name: ANN_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Override the User-Agent sent to Anime News Network.

environmentVariables.name: ANN_MIN_INTERVAL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum milliseconds between requests. Default 1100, floor 1000.

environmentVariables.name: ANN_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Deadline for one request, from 1000 to 120000. Default 15000.

environmentVariables.name: ANN_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Attempts after a transient failure, from 0 to 10. Default 3.

environmentVariables.name: ANN_CACHE_TTL_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long an encyclopedia entry stays in memory, from 0 to 86400000. Default 3600000.

environmentVariables.name: ANN_NEWS_CACHE_TTL_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long a news feed stays in memory, from 0 to 86400000. Default 300000.

environmentVariables.name: ANN_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES
environmentVariables.description: Answers held in memory at once, from 0 to 10000. Default 200.

environmentVariables.name: ANN_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: silent, error, info or debug. Default error.
